description: REEF3D::SEASTATE GSE closure (A 776 2, Phase 25, 0060): a swell field of 200 x 200 km (A 727 the box of the initial spectrum A 710 1, Tp 12 s, 20 deg) in deep water on 60 x 40 cells of 20 km, 12 x 24 bins, second order (A 796 2), 20 steps of 1800 s; after the transport of each step the flux inside a bin as a diffusion D = t_a Sigma with t_a the model time, 2 Gauss-Seidel iterations (A 778). Validation in Dropbox SEASTATE/validation/79_gse.
